crucialFeats: Picks up and slams down a Y-Wing bomber.
Slams two starships together with telekinesis.
Impales himself to kill the reborn Darth Maul.
Blocks an energy blast with his hand.
Survives a giant explosion that destroys a casino.

dossier.advantage: Elite precision and an iron defense. His mastery of the Force allows him to control the environment and the enemy's body, preventing effective counterattacks.
dossier.mentality: Cold, patient, and ruthless. He waits for the smallest mistake from the opponent to end the fight with a single, vengeful strike.
dossier.quote: All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men.
dossier.style: Technical pressure fighting with the Force. He combines perfect lightsaber swordsmanship with brutal telekinesis to choke and crush opponents in close quarters.

fighterA.name: Darth Vader

powers: Force telekinesis, precognition, and choke and crush techniques.
tools: Defensive saber discipline, elite lightsaber lethality, blaster and energy deflection, and Force-based battlefield control.
weaknesses: Dependence on armor and cybernetic life support, which an opponent can disable or damage.

crucialFeats: Destroys a planet during a fight with Drax.
Tanks multiple Black Bolt screams, including one at point blank range.
Performs matter transmutation, turning living beings into stone.

dossier.advantage: Extreme durability and tactical genius. Thanos possesses a body capable of surviving attacks from godlike beings and a mind that capitalizes on any mistake immediately.
dossier.mentality: A fanatic of his own order with iron discipline. Thanos fights with absolute certainty in his superiority, treating domination over the weak as something natural and inevitable.
dossier.quote: I did not force you to fight me. You forced me into doing what I did. I had to be faithful to my nature. For, after all, I am Thanos.
dossier.style: Brutal, precise powerhouse combat. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.

fighterB.name: Thanos

powers: Massive strength and durability, cosmic energy projection, force fields, and matter manipulation.
tools: Strategic intellect, combat adaptability, and broad resistance profile.
weaknesses: Arrogance and tendency to test opponents can create early openings.

victories: Beta Ray Bill and Ronan the Accuser

battle-dynamics.label: Immediate Execution
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Vader attempts an opening with the Force and his lightsaber. Thanos ignores the attack, takes control, and ends the fight immediately.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Vader has no real path to killing Thanos. This fight ends immediately.

fight-simulation.label: Final Verdict
fight-simulation.opening: Vader opens with a full Force assault, trying to break Thanos immediately.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Nothing works. Thanos ignores the Force and the lightsaber without taking real damage.
fight-simulation.late_fight: After Vader's first failed attempt, Thanos ends the fight immediately.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Thanos closes the gap once, breaks through Vader's defense, and ends the fight before it truly begins.

final-summary.line_1: Darth Vader possesses technique and control that could kill almost any being, but Thanos is beyond his scale.
final-summary.line_2: Vader's offense does not give him a reliable path to permanently breaking Thanos's durability.
final-summary.line_3: Once the first opening fails, the fight immediately turns into a one-sided execution.

tactical-board.lane: Vader must solve the fight fast. Thanos only needs one opening to fail.
tactical-board.subtitle: Sith Lord versus Titan

direct-verdict.line_1: Darth Vader possesses technique and control that could kill almost any being, but Thanos operates on a different level of physics.
direct-verdict.line_2: Vader's destructive opening is but a test for the Titan's durability, which he passes without much difficulty.
direct-verdict.line_3: This is a clash of whether lightsaber precision can find a gap in armor that has survived galactic explosions.
